# GameplayBehavior

8 tools. Back to the [index](README.md).

## `create_behavior_config`

Create (or load, idempotent) a UGameplayBehaviorConfig data asset.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_name` | string | yes | Name of the new config asset. |
| `package_path` | string | no | Destination /Game folder (default /Game/MCP). |
| `behavior_class` | string | no | Optional UGameplayBehavior subclass name to assign as BehaviorClass (set via reflection). |

**Returns:** `{ config_path: string, config_name: string, behavior_class: string, created: bool, saved: bool }`

## `end_behavior_on_actor`

Stop a UGameplayBehavior running on a Pawn in the editor world.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the Pawn actor in the editor world. |
| `behavior_class` | string | no | Optional UGameplayBehavior subclass to stop; defaults to UGameplayBehavior (stop all). |

**Returns:** `{ actor_label: string, behavior_class: string, ended: bool }`

## `get_behavior_config_info`

Read the BehaviorClass from a UGameplayBehaviorConfig (via reflection).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Content path of the UGameplayBehaviorConfig. |

**Returns:** `{ config_path: string, behavior_class: string, behavior_class_path: string, has_behavior_class: bool }`

## `get_behavior_subsystem_info`

Probe the UGameplayBehaviorSubsystem availability in the editor world.

No parameters.

**Returns:** `{ world_name: string, subsystem_available: bool, subsystem_class: string }`

## `list_behavior_configs`

Enumerate every UGameplayBehaviorConfig asset under a package path via AssetRegistry.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `package_path` | string | no | Optional path filter (default "/Game"). Pass "" to scan all. |

**Returns:** `{ package_path, total, configs:[{ config_path, config_name, behavior_class }] }`

## `remove_behavior_config`

Destroy a UGameplayBehaviorConfig data asset (mirror of create_behavior_config). Typed-delete: it loads the asset and REFUSES to delete it if it is not a UGameplayBehaviorConfig, so it cannot wipe the wrong asset the way the generic delete_asset can. Idempotent on missing assets.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Full /Game/... asset path of the config. |

**Returns:** `{ config_path, deleted, already_existed, asset_class?, note? }`

## `set_behavior_class`

Set the BehaviorClass of a UGameplayBehaviorConfig (via reflection; the field is protected in 5.7).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Content path of the UGameplayBehaviorConfig. |
| `behavior_class` | string | yes | UGameplayBehavior subclass name (with or without "U" prefix). |

**Returns:** `{ config_path: string, behavior_class: string, set: bool, saved: bool }`

## `trigger_behavior_on_actor`

Trigger a UGameplayBehaviorConfig on a Pawn in the editor world.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `config_path` | string | yes | Content path of the UGameplayBehaviorConfig. |
| `actor_label` | string | yes | Label of the Pawn actor in the editor world to receive the behavior. |

**Returns:** `{ config_path: string, actor_label: string, behavior_class: string, triggered: bool }`
